title: Ford Crown Victoria Engines (1980–2011)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Crown Victoria and LTD Crown Victoria by year, 1980–2011: the Windsor V8s and the 4.6 Modular, including Police Interceptors.
intro: Ford's Panther-platform LTD Crown Victoria arrived for 1980 and became simply the Crown Victoria for 1992. The Police Interceptor carried its own ratings. The last US models were 2011s.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: LTD Crown Victoria
intro: The 302 and 351 Windsor V8s, the 255 in 1981–1982, and the 351 HO police engine; fuel injection from 1983.
The 4.6 SOHC Modular V8, with dual exhaust on the Police Interceptor and handling package, and a CNG version.
The 4.6 Modular V8 in single- and dual-exhaust form, with flex-fuel capability in later years.
